newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares mired at lower levels mid-bourse.
newsitem.headline: German shares mired at lower levels mid-bourse.

text.p: 1010 GMT - German shares continue to trade at lower levels mid-bourse, down nearly two percent on Monday with the market tracking losses seen in late electronic trade on Friday. Trading sentiment unsettled by Friday's sharp declines and a lack of new data to help lift the market in any significant fashion. Support comes from dollar, dealers say volumes low.
* Main volumes seen in bank stocks -- Commerzbank Deutsche Bank, Hypo-Bank, Dresdner -- all trading lower.
